text: The 2021 tree-cover loss within the asset is supported by independent evidence. The Hansen Global Forest Change dataset (GFC-2025-v1.13) mapped a loss of about 81.3 hectares in 2021. This is corroborated by the JRC GFC2020 dataset, which agrees on 98% of the event area being forested in 2020. Additionally, the MGAP forest map from 2021 indicates that the area was planted forest, primarily consisting of Pinus elliottii and Pinus taeda. The evidence supports the occurrence of tree-cover loss but does not specify the cause or legality of the change.
